guide.content1: Dear users, welcome to the profits and Earnings guide. We will introduce you to the profits and earnings structure in our company, to help you plan your work schedule better. All employees profits and earnings consist of three parts, Daily profits, Reset bonuses and Basic salary. Daily profits are the most important source of income for you. You earn the Reset bonus and Basic salary when you meet certain requirements set by the Merchants.
guide.content2: The company utilizes a cumulative sign-in system for the salary payment structure, designed to incentivize users to actively engage in their mission on a daily basis. While the basic salary is fixed, it is not paid in a lump sum. Instead, the company disburses the basic salary after a specified number of working days, such as 2 days, 4 days, or 10 days, to encourage consistent daily mission completion. Once users complete the required number of working days, the company will pay them accordingly.
guide.title3: Sign In . Show Up . Get Paid
guide.content3: For monthly pay, sign in and maintain your profit, you can gain guaranteed income!
guide.content4: The more you active up, the more you earn. Invite to Start!
guide.content5: Perfect attendance will earn you up to USD 7,000 per month.
guide.content6: The Reset rewards is one of the most importantsources of income when you first start working withus. All users are allowed to work on two sets ofmission per day, and the merchants offer differentadditional Reset rewards in order to encourage usersto carry out their dally tasks. You will receive anadditional 10USD bonus each time you reset youraccount to start frist mission with 100USD, and whenyour cumulative reset amount exceeds 1500USD in aday, you will receive an additional 4% of thecumulative amount for two sets in a day
